title: KIN-SYS Protocol: Provider-Neutral Governed Execution Prototype
description: KIN-SYS is a provider-neutral protocol architecture for governing and verifying digital instructions across institutional and jurisdictional boundaries. This 0.1.0 software release preserves a runnable local synthetic reference prototype with MINAH-first instruction ingress, identity and action-specific authority gates, CEE-controlled execution with IVM transition checks, durable local SQLite journals, explicit decision outcomes, operation inspection, and bounded recovery tooling. The repository includes reproducible tests, a process-level HTTP smoke test, paired comparison harnesses, and documented architecture and assurance limits. This is a research/reference prototype, not a production deployment: MINAH, identity and authority adapters, legal rules, institutional decisions, and payment interactions are synthetic or test doubles; no live external services or real funds are involved; distributed finality, production authentication/TLS, and production cryptographic trust infrastructure are not claimed.
